title: Decrease connection speed precision
line: The Networks widget now shows connection speed rounded with the right unit (1.2 GBit/s, 867 MBit/s) and hides it when the speed is unknown.
explanation: UiUtils::connectionSpeed() received NetworkManager's speed in kbit/s but labelled values under 1000 as 'Bit/s', and printed the rest as raw doubles, so a 1200900 kbit/s link showed '1.2009 GBit/s'. When the driver reports no speed (0), the Details still showed a '0 Bit/s' row. The change labels small values as kBit/s, rounds MBit/s to whole numbers and GBit/s to three significant digits, and skips the Connection speed row for wired and Wi-Fi devices when the speed is 0.

commits.message:
libs/editor: round connection speed and hide it when unknown

NetworkManager reports the speed in kbit/s, but values below 1000 were
labelled Bit/s and the rest was printed unrounded, as in 1.2009 GBit/s.
Use the right unit, round the speed, and skip the row when it's zero.

BUG: 481301
